emptyState.title: No glossary yet
emptyState.description: A glossary fixes how your terms are heard and translated during a meeting — product names, acronyms, and words whose meaning depends on your field. Terms here override the platform-wide glossary. Already have a list? Import a CSV or spreadsheet instead of typing it out.

emptyTerms.titleEmpty: This glossary has no terms yet
emptyTerms.description: Add the words this workspace wants heard and translated a particular way, or import a CSV or spreadsheet you already have.

newGlossary.title: New glossary
newGlossary.description: One glossary covers one direction of translation. Add another for a second language pair.

addTerm.title: Add term
addTerm.description: Applied live, to both speech recognition and translation, for every meeting in this workspace.

import.title: Import terms
import.description: Into <glossaryName></glossaryName>. A row near the top must name the columns; <term>Term</term> and <translation>Translation</translation> are required. Field, Definition, Note, Part of speech and Priority are used when present.
import.expectedPairSame: This glossary is {source} → {target}, so the second column is what each term means rather than a translation.
import.expectedPairDifferent: This glossary is {source} → {target}. The second column should be {target}.
import.columnsFoundButEmpty: The columns were found, but every row below them was empty.
import.missingColumns: The first row must name the columns, and must include a Term column and a Translation column.
import.fileCouldNotBeRead: That file could not be read ({detail}). Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again, or start from the sample below.
import.rowsReady: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} ready. Terms already in this glossary are skipped, and the count is reported after the import.
import.showingFirst: Showing the first 50 of {count}. All {count} will be imported.

toasts.imported: Imported {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}}.
toasts.importedSkipped: Imported {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}}, skipped {skipped} already in this glossary.
toasts.glossaryCreatedWithTerms: Glossary created with {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}}.
toasts.glossaryTermsFailed: Glossary created, but its terms could not be added.
